title: Principles of data processing
rules: Personal data must be processed lawfully, fairly, and transparently
Data must be collected for specified, explicit purposes
Storage limitation: data should not be kept longer than necessary

title: Lawfulness of processing
rules: Processing requires explicit consent or lawful basis
Consent must be freely given, specific, informed

title: Automated decision-making
rules: Users have the right to not be subject to fully automated decisions
Decisions must be explainable when impacting individuals
